task.question: What was the outcome of the 2026 São Toméan presidential election in July?
task.evidence: July 19 – The 2026 São Toméan presidential election was held, with incumbent nonpartisan President Carlos Vila Nova re-elected for a second five-year term.

answer:
The outcome of the 2026 São Toméan presidential election held on July 19 was that incumbent president Carlos Vila Nova won re-election in the first round with 55.88% of the vote, while his main opposition, Nito Abreu, received 41.46%. The voter turnout was 41%. 

FINAL: Carlos Vila Nova re-elected

[2026 São Toméan presidential election] Presidential elections were held in São Tomé and Príncipe on 19 July 2026. Incumbent president Carlos Vila Nova won re-election in the first round, this time running as an independent candidate with support from MLSTP–PSD, receiving 55.88% of the vote, while his main opposition candidate, Nito Abreu, who was supported by Vila Nova's former party Independent Democratic Action, reached 41.46%. The turnout reached a record low of 41%.
